publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In accordance with the fact that current incremental location estimation methods have ignored the real characteristics of environment, an incremental location estimation method based on feasible weighted least squares (LE-FWLS) method is proposed. This algorithm has considered the deployment environment of wireless sensor network, it only uses a small number of beacon nodes, and the networking characteristics of wireless sensor network have been considered, such as multi-hop and accumulation of errors. The improved algorithm can overcome various problems, such as the large error of positioning result caused by accumulated errors and difficulty to implement the location estimation method due to unavailable weights in traditional incremental location estimation methods. It uses the residual error obtained in each computation as the weight matrix, so it can accurately reflect the situation of error accumulation. Related experiments have also proved the feasibility, stability and practicality of this algorithm, and it can significantly increase the positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Non-contiguous channel bonding via NC-OFDM for using TV white spaces
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Contiguous channel bonding has been considered in IEEE 802.22 standard to use more than one channel in TV white spaces. To support more flexible channel usage of TV white spaces, this paper investigates non-contiguous channel bonding via NC-OFDM (Non-Continuous OFDM) technique. The system model of NC-OFDM transmission for non-contiguous channel bonding is presented and the system performance is studied by simulation. The simulation results show that non-contiguous channel bonding achieves better SER (Symbol Error Rate) performance and results in slightly higher PAPR (Peak to Average Power Ratio) compared with contiguous channel bonding.

articleTitle: An OFDM-PON symbol synchronization technology based on absolute value error of training sequence
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: A simple, low cost and robust OFDM-PON symbol synchronization technology is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The main idea of this algorithm is to make use of the periodicity of the OFDM symbol to achieve symbol and frame synchronization at the receiver. This technology is applicable for the OFDM-PON system as some simple subtraction is required but without any multiplication. Using the proposed synchronization algorithm, a real-time OFDM-PON signal transmission at 2.5Gb/s over 25km standard single-mode fiber is achieved and the optical power of -12.5dBm corresponds to the system bit error rate of only 0.11634%. And most importantly, it provides the real time symbol synchronization for the point-to-point and point-to-multipoint OFDM-PON network.

articleTitle: New algorithm for IEEE 1588 time synchronization under the presence of significant delay variation
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Time synchronization is one of the basic services in a distributed network as it enables a lot of services, for example synchronized measurements or timeslot-based access to shared communication media. The IEEE 1588 defines the precision time protocol (PTP) that aims to synchronize multiple slave clocks to a master clock by means of synchronization event messages. Unfortunately, the accuracy of time synchronization strongly depends on delay variations produced by the underlying telecom network. Such behavior represents a strong issue, particularly considering the network consisting of devices that are not IEEE 1588 capable. A conventional clock servo will not provide enough accurate level of synchronization in the case of considerable delay variation. We develop a novel time synchronization algorithm that is based on a generic statistical approach and explicitly takes into account the stochastic properties of delay of PTP messages. Numerical simulations show that this algorithm is effective for estimation of the time offset between master and slave reliably, even under significant delay variations.

articleTitle: Distance education support platform based on web services
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Distance education by e-learning system is the teaching or learning process in which students are separated from the other students, the instructors and the learning resources. It focuses on teaching methods and technology with the aim of delivering knowledge and related resources to the students who can not learn at the classroom. Distance education becomes more and more important in lifelong learning era, especially for the people in impoverished areas, mountainous areas, and so like. In this paper, we introduce a distance education support platform based on web services and information and communication technology to improve the quality of education in remote and poverty-stricken areas. By this platform, the learner and teacher could download high quality learning resources, and communicate with many famous teachers.

articleTitle: Spectrum aanlyses of UNB modulation formats
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: How to improve spectral efficiency is one of the hot research topics in communication technology. Ultra Narrow Band (UNB) is a special modulation method to try to improve spectral efficiency. There are several modulation formats called UNB. In order to explore its essentials, this article presents a compressive research and analysis and comparison from the point of frequency domain based on the common modulation methods. The essential attributes are achieved through frequency analysis. Further this can be used as the guide in the process of waveform design.

articleTitle: Blackdroid: A black-box way for Android plaintext and ciphertext privacy leaks detecting and guarding
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Constantly emerging third-party apps bring huge convenience and enjoyment to Android users. However, vulnerabilities of Android's own permission management mechanism allow apps to read user's privacy data and send them outside without the user's consent. In this paper, we provide Blackdroid, a light weight plaintext and ciphertext privacy leaks detecting and controlling solution for Android. Based on preset labels, Blackdroid tracks the flow of text privacy data in third-party apps via a black-box way, and drops the bad packages containing privacy if necessary. We tested 4428 popular apps from Chinese Android market Gfan using Blackdroid. Of the tested apps, 21.7% send out packages carrying sensitive contents. In performance experiments, we observed only 4.5% time overload gain in internet package sending out phase.

articleTitle: A study and instantiation of executable domain-specific modeling
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Model is the description and specification of software functions, structure, behaviour and its environment. One of the most important things is to strive to achieve automatically built software according to domain model, to verify the software in developing is better than that of software requirements. This paper integrates domain-specific modeling and web service techniques with model-driven development, then proposes a unified approach, SODSMI to build the executable domain-specific model to achieve the target of model-driven development. In this paper, a case study to construct an online shopping system is introduced for demonstrating the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Game theory based automatic uplink power control in mobile cellular network
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In this paper, transmission power control problem for uplink in mobile cellular network is investigated and a new autonomic uplink power control scheme was proposed based on stochastic differential game. It is proved that the non-cooperative differential game algorithm is applicable and the optimal power level can be achieved.

articleTitle: A study of the USDX based on ARIMA model — A correlation analysis between the USDX and the Shanghai index
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In order to predict and describe the volatility of the U.S. dollar index, the ARIMA model is used to study the U.S. dollar index. After establishing the time series model, we use the model to predict future trends of the U.S. dollar index the results show that ARIMA model is a proper short-term forecasting method. It is effective when predicting for a month. Then in order to get further analysis of USDX, we study the correlation between the Shanghai index and the U.S. Dollar Index, and found there is a strong negative relationship between them.

articleTitle: Research and practice of open test database system based on cloud architecture
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Open test database system based on cloud architecture uses the architecture mode of cloud computing and cloud storage, through accessing a browser, achieves real-time LAN and Internet database management functions. The system not only to achieve a dynamic courses management, dynamic examination questions management and dynamic test paper management, but also to provide a prerequisite for the open teaching. And it further promote the changes of learning idea and transformations of learning mode in student.

articleTitle: Research of remote environmental data monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: To keep pace with the progress in measurement and control technology and give people a smarter lifestyle, this paper designs a wireless sensor network (WSN) for remote environmental data monitoring use, which focuses on the system architecture and key technologies. As a validation of the proposed scheme, we achieved a web-based remote monitoring system, which is successfully used in ship environmental monitoring. This system is real time and accurately for data collecting, and is easily to be deployed.

articleTitle: An adaptive active queue management algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: When we face the request of the massive users and the dynamic change of network, the existing active queue management mechanism can not satisfy the effectiveness, stability and robustness at the same time, thus we can't better control the congestion state of the network. This paper based on PI (Proportional Integral) algorithm, it proposed an adaptive PI active queue management algorithm API(Adaptive Proportional Integral). API gets the current queue length by real-time monitoring router buffer queue. Based on the current queue length with the target queue length deviation, it dynamically adjusts the relevant parameters in PI algorithm and the packet loss probability. Through the ns-2 simulations, it shows that, API has a faster response speed and a smaller queue jitter than PI algorithm, in the dynamic change of network, it shows a better stability and robustness, and more effective to alleviate the network congestion.

articleTitle: The application of 3S in investigation and design of electric power transmission line
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The paper gives a brief discussion of how to collect terrain data from papery topographic maps to generate DTM, and introduces the method of making orthoimages with radiometric correction and geometry rectification. DTM data and orthoimages are used as the basis for designing transmitting lines and generating section maps. 3D data and GPS are utilized for field survey. Finally GPS field survey data are added into images to modify and settle position of telegraph poles.

articleTitle: The design and obtainment of micro mobile learning content expression forms
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Mobile learning is a learning method developed to meet requirements of the era with the development of Internet. In order to promote the development of mobile learning, the theoretical basis, principles, expression forms and characteristics of micro-mobile learning are studied in this paper. Moreover, we summarized the developing platform and technology together with the realization mode of micro-mobile learning content expression forms. Some feasible designs and development methods were proposed for providing some useful information to the study of micro-mobile learning.

articleTitle: Design of a modular and open innovative experiment and practice platform for electronic information
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: An experimental teaching platform that is modular, multilevel and open is proposed in this paper aiming at solving the defects of the traditional experimental box mode and it is mainly composed of the common basic platform and the experimental resource board. This paper chiefly investigates the functional requirements and design projects of the basic platform and resource board. Furthermore, the signal computation module is taken as an example to elaborate on the experimental teaching content of the cell module and the method of the cell plate design, and finally the application effect of the experimental platform is also summarized.

articleTitle: An effective low-delay routing algorithm in opportunistic networks
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: To address the problems of large transmission delay and low success rate in DBGRS (Direction Based Geographic Routing Scheme), we propose an novel routing algorithm which optimizes the process of data forwarding and makes full use of the information in the neighbor table to achieve the goal of reducing the transmission delay and increasing the success rate. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that our proposed algorithm outperforms DBGRS in terms of average delay, number of packets transmission, and the success rate of packets transmission.

articleTitle: J2EE-based authentication system of expansive training for the university student
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The paper presents an authentication system that allows the user to query expansive training certification records for the university student. Firstly, we analyze the requirements of authentication system and come up with feasible solutions on the basis of learning the plan on expansive training to the cultivation of student quality. Before carrying out the system, the paper introduces the design thought of developing the system and the network technology it needs, and decides the design idea of oriented object, technique standard of J2EE and Web Service as technical solutions. In the end of the paper, it mainly discusses how to apply the J2EE technology to design the whole framework of authentication system.

articleTitle: Design of anti-collision system at mountain road turn based on wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Due to the complexity and changeability of mountain roads, the accident rate is substantially higher than that of other types of roads, especially at road turns. Although numerous preventive measures have been sought to mitigate this problem, yet fatal collisions are severe up to the present. To solve this problem, in this paper, we design an anti-collision system prototype based on wireless sensor networks (WSNs) to control traffic lights at mountain road turns. We employ Zigbee-based wireless geomagnetic sensor networks to capture real time information of vehicles near the turn and control traffic lights accordingly. We focus on node designs of sensor network and propose an algorithm for traffic lights control which shows the feasibility by a laboratory experiment. The system is low-cost and suitable for special circumstances of mountain areas. What is more, WSNs can be connected to the remote monitoring center with the help of GPRS, improving the efficiency of monitoring and management.

articleTitle: An asymmetric network coding algorithm in wireless networks
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In the existing wireless network coding mechanism, the packets used to coded are always with equal length, which is always called symmetric network coding. This coding method can effectively improve the network performance. But it also limits the further improvement of network performance in the multimedia application environment, where data packets length is usually unequal. Here we propose an asymmetric network coding mechanism. Through splicing combination of the packets, asymmetric network coding could overcome the shortage of symmetric network coding.

articleTitle: An improved algorithm based on noise estimation
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of noise estimation in the non-stationary environment, this paper proposes a new improved noise estimation algorithm. The minimum searching is depended on a fixed length of time window instead of fixed window, compare with the traditional algorithm, this algorithm can improve the tracking delay. The smoothing parameter can be calculated through constraining the variance. Simulation results show that this algorithm possesses a more short delay in tracking the behavior of the background noise, and it has a lower mean square error of noise estimation. Smoothing parameter can be calculated through constraining the variance. Simulation results show that this algorithm possesses a more short delay in tracking the behavior of the background noise, and it has a lower mean square error of noise estimation.

articleTitle: The neural network model of communication software maintainability assessment
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In order to assess the communication software maintainability in a credible, simple and shortcut way, The fuzzy comprehensive assessment system based on BP neural network is used in this paper. By introducing the fuzzy matrix and BP neural network, the assessment conclusion is accurate when the model is trained. The model mainly consists four steps: the first one is to construct the index system of the software system. The second one is to construct the basic data model. In this step, we need to confirm the fuzzy evaluation matrix, the comprehensive assessment matrix, the evaluation index's weight and the comprehensive assessment result. The third one is to construct the fuzzy comprehensive assessment system based on BP neural network. In this step, expert review samples is used as the learning samples of neural network and then assessment system is used to get the assessment conclusion by calculation. The last one is to use expert evaluation system based on three level BP neural network. After test, it's appoved that there are the application value of using the fuzzy comprehensive assessment system based on BP neural network to Communication software maintainability's assessment.

articleTitle: Research on buffer management mechanisms of IEEE 802.16m saving scheme
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The IEEE 802.16m network is the most popular network in Wireless Metropolitan Area Networks (WMANs). A user can send data from mobile devices to the Internet via IEEE 802.16m networks. An IEEE 802.16m network officially supports a power saving mechanism to make mobile devices work longer. In IEEE 802.16m networks, a base station caches data destined to a mobile device when the mobile device enters the sleep mode. When the mobile device wakes up, the base station sends the cached data to the mobile device in order to avoid data loss. Without a good buffer management mechanism, a base station may have buffer overflow to lose data if a mobile device sleeps a long time. In this paper, we propose a mechanism named Dynamic Buffer Management (DBM) to efficiently manage buffers of a base station in order to avoid the occurrence of buffer overflow. In simulations, DBM can reduce the occurrences of buffer overflow and data delay in IEEE 802.16m networks to efficiently utilize resources in networks.

articleTitle: Research on the architecture of database intrusion protection system in e-commerce environment
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Security has been a critical issue in e-commerce, where absolute security confidentiality of information exchange is requited. Because of the shortage of traditional database security protection mechanism, an active database intrusion prevention system is proposed to monitor the database application layer activities. The architecture of database intrusion prevention system is designed, including a security control module, intrusion detection module, audit and configuration module as well as alarm module, which could be applied in e-commerce applications.

articleTitle: Multimedia education resources management based on service oriented architecture
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Distance education with e-learning comprises all forms of electronically supported learning and teaching resources, and is essentially the computer and network-enabled transfer of skills and knowledge. This paper introduces a multimedia education resource management method used in e-learning support platform. In the proposed method, the education resources are divided into small unit called coarse grain resource according to the content and meanings of the resources, which is much complex and bigger than a single multimedia material such as text, graphics, image, audio, video, etc. The coarse grain resource composes of multiple media materials and always corresponds to an integrated and specialized knowledge unit. By this way, the education resources could be more easily and effectively managed, maintained and shared; and the learning support platform could provide more better services and satisfy various needed of different users.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of E-commerce based on credibility theory
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The Chinese social informationization should start from the premise that the E-Commerce risk is scientifically assessed. Through introducing axiomatic credibility measure and classical analytic hierarchy process, we construct a multilevel risk assessment model based on credibility theory. For the complexity of multi-objective decision making in the process of E-commercial risk assessment, we have established the multilevel indicators system, and then have evaluated the ECommerce risk by the risk assessment model proposed in this paper, which demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of the model. The multi-level risk assessment model based on credibility theory can effectively avoid subjective problem for selecting membership function in fuzzy evaluation, and thus the result of assessment is more scientific and objective.

articleTitle: Design of FPGA based frame transceiver of MVBC
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: A design of frame transceiver of Multifunction Vehicle Bus Controller (MVBC) utilized by FPGA is proposed in this paper. Firstly at all, on the basis of analyzing the MVB communication mechanisms and characteristics, the algorithm of the MVBC frame transceiver core functions has been described by the VHDL language, such as Manchester encoder and decoder (CODEC), Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) and so on. Then, the transmitter module and receiver module have been designed. At last, the transmitting and receiving of MVB master frame and slave frame have been realized on FPGA.

articleTitle: Design of liquid crystal digital voltmeter based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The design is based on Atmel51 microcontroller development platform and automatic control based on the principle of a digital voltage meter system. The system uses Atmel89C52 microcontroller as the control core, ADC0832 for the sampled data system, The use of a zener diode for over voltage protection, and through the realization of analog switch achieves the input range automatic conversion, character liquid crystal display shows the measured voltage.

articleTitle: An inter-device positioning method based on inertial sensors and wireless signal strength
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: This paper proposes an inter-device positioning method based on inertial sensors and wireless signal strength. Many applications request relative position between two mobile devices, such as monitoring and tour guiding. However, the existing positioning methods have many problems. For example, some of them need complex deployments and they are lack of flexibility. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an infrastructure-free inter-device positioning method. Using geometrical method, this positioning method calculates the relative position between two devices through measuring the distance and position change between two devices in the moving process. The method only requires the basic wireless chips and inertial sensors equipped into the mobile device instead of any external infrastructures. Furthermore, the device can move casually during the positioning process without limitations, making the positioning process very flexible.

articleTitle: OAC: An optimized transmission scheme for flexible communication reliability in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Due to the high packet loss rate during multi-hop transmissions in wireless sensor networks, a reliable end-to-end delivery scheme is desired. But, in some applications, there is no need of 100% communication reliability (CR). Active caching is a novel scheme which can satisfy the flexible CR. However, in this scheme, only caching nodes can detect missing packets, so the retransmission efficiency is low. In this paper, we propose a more efficient scheme named OAC (optimized active caching) which exploits the broadcasting nature of wireless communication to detect packet loss. The results based on simulation show that the proposed scheme has advantages in retransmission counts and time-delay. And thus energy is saved at the same time.

articleTitle: The research of parallel-light shadow map of 3D scene
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Shadow is an important visual cue in 3D scene, which provides the information about spatial relations among objects and the information of light sources. The current research on real-time shadow generation which is important for multimedia system mainly concentrated on the point-light shadow map (traditional SM). Due to the rapid development of computer vision, the traditional point-light shading effect has been unable to meet the diversity and high simulation requirements. While parallel-light shading have become the focus of study and research reasonably. Aimed at this topic, this paper suggests an improved shadow map algorithm aimed at realizing shadows of parallel light, which will guarantee not only the convenience but also the rendering rate.

articleTitle: Design of self-cleanout control system for air filter based on LOGO!
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: To upgrade safety and reliability of Self-cleanout Control System for Air Filter, the Siemens programmable logic controller LOGO! was introduced, then the Self-cleanout Control of multi-Air Filter was realized. The actual applications get better results.

articleTitle: An outer bound on secrecy achievable rate region for BCE
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: This paper considers the problems of the achievable rate regions on broadcast channel with the eavesdropper (BCE). Many articles have given the meaningful results, like the inner bound of this model. However, the specific analysis processes for this model have not been given by previous work, especially, the outer bound of BCE have not been given. So we focus on the study of the outer bound on the secrecy achievable rate regions of BCE and obtain a convincing result.

articleTitle: A cleaning method of noise data in RFID data streams
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In recent years, RFID technology is gradually applied to the field of real-time monitoring, positioning, tracking, etc. As the unreliability of RFID data, the development and the application of RFID technology are limited. In certain practical applications, false negative reading can be solved by multi-reading periodically. However, false positive reading (ie, noise) provided the wrong information to high-level RFID applications. For example, readers are installed on the shopping shelf, they send false anti-theft alarms due to false positive reading. False positive reading has seriously affected the promotion and application of RFID technology. Therefore, it is necessary to design an efficient and feasible method to eliminate false positive reading. The paper proposes an efficient cleaning mechanism to solve the false positive problem in RFID data streams. The result of experiment shows that the method is effective and efficient.

articleTitle: Digital broadband the system of direction fuzzy model solution
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The interferometer electronic reconnaissance in extensive use of field. In order to further improve the accuracy direction-finding interferometer and enhance the ability to adapt to the broadband signal and extended system work frequency range, this paper puts forward the digital broadband solution for the system of direction and discusses the probability solution fuzzy algorithm and antenna array baseline design. The simulation design example shows that the system can adapt to the broadband signal, lateral high precision and working frequency range wide.

articleTitle: Dual-band printed antenna for vehicular SDARS and GPS applications
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: A vehicular printed antenna for SDARS and GPS application is presented in this paper. The proposed antenna was printed on a FR4 substrate which is intended to be pasted onto the windshield of a car. The antenna has an overall size of 50 mm × 40 mm × 0.5 mm and consists of a semicircular slot and a rectangular-shaped ground plane, it can generate resonant mode at about 1.575 and 2.3385 GHz respectively. A 50-Ω coaxial mini-cable is employed to feed the antenna via a CPW structure. Both simulated and measured results show that the proposed antenna prototype achieves good impedance matching and omnidirectional radiation over the operating bandwidth at 1.5-1.62 GHz and 2.25-2.40 GHz, so that it is desirable for vehicular application as a SDARS and GPS dual-band antenna.

articleTitle: Spectrum estimation of harmonics based on the ESPRIT method under alpha-stable noise
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Traditional spectrum estimation of harmonics has been developed under the condition that the sub-space vectors of noises are Gaussian distributed, but the variance which is the second order statistics of fractional lower order stable distribution is infinite value. This paper briefly introduce the statistical characteristics of alpha stable distribution, analyses the fractional order correlation matrix structure through the definition of the fractional p-order correlation, proposes a new method of frequency estimation under alpha-stable noise conditions based on the traditional ESPRIT method. The simulation results show that the proposed method is more robust than the traditional ESPRIT.

articleTitle: Quasi-orthogonal space-time block code with Givens rotation for OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In this paper, we investigate quasi-orthogonal STBC (QOSTBC) with Givens rotation for the OFDM system over frequency selective fading channels. With Givens rotation, the correlation of channel equivalent matrix is eliminated, and the decoding of QOSTBC can be performed with linear combiner at the receiver. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme achieves the full rate transmission, and the BER performance of the proposed scheme is better than OSTBC for OFDM system in the low SNR regime.

articleTitle: A evaluation method for classified security protection of information systems based on neural network and rough set
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: While carrying out the evaluation of classified security protection of information systems by means of the traditional expert evaluation method, the evaluation results are less accurate and more subjective, and largely depend on the professional ability and working experience of the evaluator. In order to solve this issue, this paper presents an evaluation method for classified security protection of information systems based on rough set and neural network. In this method, firstly, by using fuzzy theory, the quantitative decision table of evaluation indicators can be established with the help of domain experts, and then by using rough set, an attribute reduction algorithm is used to preprocess the sample data in the decision table, finally, these sample data can be used for BP neural network training. The trained neural network is taken as the evaluation model of classified security protection of information systems.

articleTitle: Discretization of the gradient field total variation model and application in image denoising
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In this paper, a discrete implementation method of the gradient field total variation is deduced, analyzed and tested. We use it to remove the noise in the image. The experiment result the shows that this method is better than the traditional denoising method based on the filter. It is mainly because that, in this method, the gradient of the image is kept unchanged when denoised. At last, It is proved that this method is correct.

articleTitle: Applications of fuzzy self-adaptive PID control in paper tension control
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Rotary press tension control works as a key control section in affecting the quality of printing products. Particularly, it plays a major role to overprint precision. This paper analysed several factors affecting rotary press tension control and difficult problems regarding setting parameters of conventional PID control in tension control. On the basis of fuzzy self-adaptive PID tension control device, the paper attempted to adjust real-time parameters K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</sub>, and K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> according to deviation and deviation rate. The paper further analysed principles of fuzzy self-adaptive PID control and sectional functions. Then the paper designed a solution to tension control applying fuzzy self-adaptive PID. Practice indicated that fuzzy self-adaptive PID has better control characteristics than conventional PID controller in tension control. Exogenous interference has no effect on the basic tension control way, making paper tension control performance to be fast, accurate and stable.

articleTitle: Studies on demand management of farmland information system based agile development method
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Researching demands based on agile development method, demands obtained, demands traced and demand response. By the flexibility of method, the analysis of a environment farmland information system can help obtain demands flexibly, and response demands actively to reduced risk of the project. Based on the analysis of the iteration plan and results, agile demand management method is suitable for farmland information system development activities.

articleTitle: Research and application of 16-bit A/D electronic converter chip ADS8344N
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In the process of electronic instruments design, it is very common to convert analog signals to digital signals and carry on data acquisition. The conversion accuracy directly affects the accuracy of data acquisition, affecting the accuracy of the electronic instruments. One of the most important electronic components is the AD conversion element. In this paper, we designed a sampling circuit with 16-bit, 8-channel serial output analog-to-digital converter ADS8344N which was controlled by the programming microcontroller. Take the application of ADS8344N in gas concentration monitoring electronic instrument as an example, we introduced the method. This method can be applied to fumigation gas concentration detection with highly precision requirements in the inspection and quarantine treatment system.

articleTitle: Casting windows to Android based on hybrid encoder model
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Along with the development of mobile internet, there are increasing devices running on top of mobile operating systems among which Android is the most popular on the earth. Ranging from screen size as big as modern TV to screen size as small as smartphone, Android is ubiquitous in mobile computing and is prevailing in every corner of our daily life. On the other hand, traditional desktop operating system like Windows owns more professional applications and stronger computing ability which are not available on devices running on Android. Hence, in this paper, we propose a hybrid encoder model to cast Windows screen to Android. Compared to classic way of solving this problem, our method is more efficient in screen casting in that a heuristic decision is made to determine whether traditional VNC mode or streaming mode is activated. The experiments between the server using our hybrid encoder model and classic VNC server show that our method takes less network bandwidth and renders more frames when sending multimedia over wireless network.

articleTitle: A stochastic programming method for IP traffic matrix estimation
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Traffic Matrices, which capture the network traffic volumes among end-points, are widely used in Internet Engineering. A traffic matrix is generally estimated from link loads because it is impossible to measure each flow directly in a large scale IP network. The estimation problem is usually considered to be an optimization model with a routing constraint which relates the traffic matrix with link loads. However, the information provided by link loads is far less than that required, and so the estimation problem becomes very ill-posed. Moreover, the random measuring noise of link loads often makes the route constraint violated. To deal with this problem, this paper proposes a stochastic programming (SP) model, which relaxes the routing constraint to a probabilistic constraint and then enlarges the feasible space of the optimization problem. By using the Abilene dataset, we simulated the proposed SP model and the Tomogravity method respectively. The simulation results show that the SP model can improve the estimation performance obviously.

articleTitle: A study on load dispatch among thermal power units based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: This paper presents a Genetic Algorithm optimizing solution (GA) for thermal power units. Based on determined load demand data (equal to output of the whole power plant) and coal consumption model, we utilize GA method to compute its minimum consumption. The simulation proves the algorithm used to solve operational problems is effective and fast convergence to the best region. At last, we try to provide other parallel tools which also can be used to solve this problem for a comparison.

articleTitle: Game analysis on the collaborative operation behavior in logistics service supply chain
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: There are three main kinds of members in logistics service supply chain: integrative logistics providers, functional logistics providers and logistics customers. Every member affects and is affected by others. An understanding of the collaborative operation behavior could provide good ideas to achieve effective coordination among members. Short-term and long-term collaborative operation behaviors are analyzed based on the game theory in the paper.

articleTitle: Study of high reliability NoC based on power gating
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Due to extensibility and high performance of Network on Chip (NoC), it has been considered as a new paradigm in the next generation communication architecture. However, increased power consumption has reduced the reliability of NoC and hindered its wide-deployment. In this paper, we propose a new design of high reliability NoC based on Power Gating, which can switch routers on or off by monitoring each port of routers. Our study shows that the proposed method is effective in reducing static power and improving reliability.

articleTitle: Research and application of radar combined teaching platform systerm
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The development of Combined teaching platform make the teaching of equipment maintenance have a fundamental change. On the one hand, teaching radar in composition, using the Combined teaching platform, we can carry out the teaching of detection and maintenance for radar composition in the same time. The chance for students of operating has been increasing greatly. The ability of detection and maintenance can be improved. On the other hand, it can make the student be familiar with the form of all kinds of signal in radar composition. So, it is of great significance for the operational ability and comprehensive quality of students.

articleTitle: Image quality assessment based on nonsubsampled contourlet transform and structural similarity
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: This paper presents a new image quality assess ment which is based on structural similarity in nonsubsampled contourlet transform (NSCT) domain. The nonsubsampled contourlet transform is introduced for its ability to represent the images at different scales and directions. Firstly, images were decomposed into subbands with different scales and directions by (NSCT). Secondly, the correlativity indexes between the reference sequences and the comparative sequences respectively were calculated in each subbands. According to information content weighting, the quality of the whole image can be obtained. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves accuracy and robustness of image quality prediction.

articleTitle: Temperature controlling system for LED lighting based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Since LEDs are generally considered to be an important lighting source of the future, an ARM-based LED intelligent lighting system was provided in this paper. According to the ambient temperature obtained by sensors, the designed system can adjust the glow color automatically to provide a pleasant lighting environment. Based on the ARM Cortex-M0 processor, the hardware and software of this system were accomplished and a series of pulse width modulation signals were generated to drive the LEDs. The testing results of the physical prototype show that the designed system works well. Thus, the preliminary research proves the possibilities of smart lighting.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of algorithms for improving surveillance video quality based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In this paper, median filter algorithm and motion vector compensation algorithm is researched. We design and implement the algorithms on the FPGA board in detail. According to the tests and experiments, we verify the practicability of the algorithms on FPGA and video surveillance system. The algorithms will effectively increase the efficiency of late video signal processing and help the application of video enhance.

articleTitle: Research of protection simulation on microwave weapons
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: This paper sets to research pointing at the threat of microwave weapons when the armed police officers and soldiers encounter in dealing with contingencies and maintaining the stability, and also discusses the shielding effectiveness of electromagnetic shielding fabric. With mental shield as the research object, use the genetic algorithm optimization principle and the HOBBIES software to simulate. Shielding effectiveness test is carried out among 3GHz~90GHz bandwidth in electromagnetic shielding fabric with single and double layer structure and then compared with the outcome of simulation.

articleTitle: The analysis and design of optic fiber methane sensor based on the spectrum absorption type
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Spectrum absorption type optic fiber gas sensor is a typical optical fiber gas sensor. The sensors use gas in the silica optical fiber (0.8 ~ 1.7 (including m) within the absorption peak, measurement of light intensity attenuation due to gas absorption, gas concentration. Common gases (such as CO, CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>). There is frequently absorption line in the silica optical fiber transmission window. The device and receiving device of this wavelength light-emitting are ideal photoelectric sensor. So most of the gas concentration can be relatively high precision measurement by this way.

articleTitle: The deployment strategy optimization and transformation of classic website group system
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In-depth study of for mainstream the website group management system market deployment architecture and found that the problems which exist points optimization strategy for the problems identified, the feasibility of the strategy through the experimental data. Units and individuals of the need for the construction of the station group to put forward constructive suggestions.

articleTitle: Cycle-spinning based contourlet denoising for multiple image
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Cycle-spinning (CS) is useful to avoid the effect of Pseudo-Gibbs phenomena, and many variations of CS method have been proposed. However, the previous work aims to reduce the noise from a single image, which result will be limited. With the thought of cyclic shift, this paper builds a novel CS-based framework for multiple images by estimating state-space relationship among the inter-frames. The unique feature of the proposed algorithm is that it is effective for the contaminated images with various noise characteristics, even if the noise information are unknown for the imaging system. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method and show the superiority to previous single image denoising methods in objective and subjective qualities.

articleTitle: An complementarity based feature selection method for pattern recognition
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: For the pattern recognition problem, this paper proposes a feature selection method based on complementarity analysis. Analyse the separability of single feature, search the feature combination with the smallest probability of mixing region and in the mixed region with the greatest separability to reduce the probability of classification error. Compared with other feature selection algorithms, data testing result shows that the feature selection method based on complementarity analysis has a lower error recognition rate than other methods, which has verified the superiority and the advanced nature of the method.

articleTitle: Improved symbol timing synchronization algorithms for SC-FDE systems
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Symbol timing synchronization is a key technology for SC-FDE (Single Carrier Frequency Domain Equalization) systems. The traditional Schmidl & Cox's and Minn's algorithms have some shortcoming on the existence of timing metric plateau and redundant peaks. To overcome these shortcomings, two symbol timing synchronization algorithms based on a novel structure of training symbol are proposed for SC-FDE systems in this paper. The proposed methods can take advantage of the correlations of the four parts of the training symbol to efficiently improve the accuracy of timing synchronization and the anti-multipath capability. The simulation results confirm that the performances of the proposed algorithms are superior to Minn's algorithm in AWGN channel and 3GPP Vehicular A channel.

articleTitle: IoT data access design of heterogeneous devices in broad sensing system
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In allusion to the Internet of Things (IoT) data access design from variant devices in the broad-sense sensing system, this paper initiates a study on Chukwa, Hadoop, and Hbase. This structural design entails a few implementations: 1. It adopts the hierarchical architecture to balance the system load; 2. An adaptor pattern is employed to match heterogeneous protocols; 3. It supports dynamic access to the sensing network. SNG, SSA, RS data flow diagram, external interface, and data structures are also presented in this paper. With certain extendibility, the system can meet the requirements for local autonomy and Ad-Hoc access.

articleTitle: The model research based on cooperative communication and location with double circular antenna array for emergency environment
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In this paper a cooperative location model based on Multiple-Input Multiple-Out-put (MIMO) communication with double circular antenna array is proposed for the needs of emergency environment, in which improved Multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm for high speed scanning beam is used combined with technologies of Space Division Multiple Access (SDMA), Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) and pulse radar location, and also methods of estimating source Direction Of Arrival (DOA) by accumulating detection, testing distance of echo wave-path difference, detecting location of clock synchronization code beacon are used as cooperative communication location and status awareness. The simulation results show that better precision and shorter time for cooperative location can be achieved with proposed model and improved MUSIC algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on audio bandwidth extension codec
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: With stereo audio stepping into people's daily lives, spatial parametric technology comes to its broad prospects for development. This paper provides the audio bandwidth extension encoding and decoding devices, the bitrate of less high-frequency signal reconstruction, in order to improve the quality of the output audio signal. This research makes a contribution to the lack of existing technology, audio bandwidth extension encoding and decoding devices, digital audio decoding to take advantage of a lower bit rate to restore the original audio signal in the digital encoding process the loss of high-frequency components, thereby enhancing the sound playback quality.

articleTitle: Research on the application of fuzzy AHP in decision-making of adopting personal online banking
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Fuzzy AHP is a kind of multi-objective decision-making and evaluation method, it combines qualitative and quantitative analysis in decision-making, and is widely used in technical, social, and economic fields. This paper applied FAHP to analyze the factors affecting decision-making of using personnel online banking. Through constructing the evaluation indicator system of intention of using personal online banking, adopting Delphi method to collect data, and using fuzzy AHP method to calculate the weights and sorting orders of indicators at all levels, the paper arrived at the sorting order of importance of the factors affecting the intention of using personal internet banking in the following proper sequence: flexibility (16.55 %), financial risk (15.56%), low binding (14.60%), privacy risk (11.38%), perceived ease of use (10.57%), consumer innovation (9.71%), perceived usefulness (8.90%), compatibility (7.14%), subjective norm (6.12%). And based on empirical conclusions, the paper puts forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions for the development of internet banking.

articleTitle: Design of digital learning resources on ubiquitous handheld terminals
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: According to the functional characters of handheld terminals, digital learning resources based on handheld terminals could be designed by means of creating situations, optimizing themes, designing efficient interactional and diverse resources. The design model is probed combined with the flow of instruction design.

articleTitle: Design of high-speed automated fingerprint identification system based on SoPC
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: A high-speed automated fingerprint SoPC identification system is designed in hardware part and software part. The pretreating process which consumes for a long time is achieved by hardware, and the matching process which consumes less time is achieved by software. This optimization improved the processing speed of system significantly.

articleTitle: An improved proxy signature scheme
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Several strong proxy signature schemes are analyzed in this paper. Since in some schemes signature verification stages without verification of the public key will easily lead to forgery attack, so the security mechanism is deficient and requires revision. Through the analysis of existing security schemes, a new proxy signature scheme is proposed, with security strengthened by the addition of public key authentication mechanism, which can effectively resist forgery attack The scheme proposed is able to make up the shortcomings of the existing schemes.

articleTitle: Monitoring technique of L1 interface protocol in CDMA2000 network system
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Based on study about the L1 interface protocol in CDMA Digital Cellular Mobile Telecommunication Network Location Based Service, this paper proposes hash algorithms and methods encapsulation to implement the monitoring module of L1 interface protocol. We provide a detailed description of the decoding scheme and the CDR synthesis algorithm of the L1 interface protocol. The scheme has been applied to the CDMA2000 monitoring system for testing. According to the test of network data, our scheme yields the expected results.

articleTitle: The technology study of fuzzy control system for asynchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The paper studies the mathematical models of asynchronous motor, and deduces the transformation models in two-phase static coordinate system and rotating coordinate system. Then the paper introduces fuzzy PID control technology, and designs the fuzzy control system for asynchronous motor, at the same time, the paper makes simulation in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The experimental results show that the fuzzy control system of asynchronous motor can enhance the anti-interference ability of the outside environment. Therefore, the fuzzy control technology is introduced in the application of asynchronous motor, and provides a very idea to the application of asynchronous motor for the majority of the scientific and technical workers.

articleTitle: Analysis and solution of the network congestions in the local area network
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In the Local Area Network, Network congestion is a problem to be solved. When packets are too much through the network, congestion maybe happens. In the severe congestion, the network can cause paralysis. This paper analyzes the causes of network congestion, with the actual proposed some effective measures to solve the network congestion.

articleTitle: Multiple research problems based on graph and network analysis
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Dijkstra algorithm, under different constraints, starting from Zhengzhou, research visits to capital cities and municipalities in the country after he returned to the starting point of the optimal path of Zhengzhou. and use approximation algorithms to find approximate optimal solution. The path of the weighted graph problem definition of a balanced group to measure the degree of grouping of the balance.

articleTitle: Virtual MIMO communication based on D2D link
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Applying MIMO technology into handheld equipments has always been a widely argued problem due to their body and power limit. The appearance of device-to-device (D2D) communication provides one way for solving this problem. In this paper, we developed the way to construct virtual antenna array by D2D links and find the method to get diversity gains using space time block coding between inter cluster communication. We focused on researching Alamouti coding which is used in virtual MIMO communication in two different ways, one is decoding and the other is amplifying. Signal combination in receiver cluster is also analyzed for increasing the possibility of decoding.

articleTitle: Robustly blind sparsity signal recovery algorithm for compressive sensing radar
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Compressive sensing (CS) is an emerging data acquisition method under the condition that the signal is sparse or compressible. However, applying CS in radar to reconstruct target scene always requires the sparsity of the echo signal is known priori with high Signal to Interference and Noise Ratio (SINR). Such an ideal assumption may not be met in practical situations. In this paper, a robustly blind sparsity recovery algorithm for compressive sensing radar (CSR) is presented. The proposed method could enhance the performance of targets detection and range-Doppler parameters estimation in low SINR without known the sparsity of the original signal with the idea of choosing supplements of the sparse signal adaptively and optimizing transmit waveform. The numerical simulations are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Signal to Interference and Noise Ratio (SINR)

articleTitle: On equipment maintenance dynamic model and its sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: For the non-periodic failure rate reduction equipment preventive maintenance, this paper studies on the equipment maintenance time optimization problem for incomplete maintenance in a finite time interval. The research aims to optimize the objective function by minimizing total maintenance costs, establish the dynamic optimization model with consideration of equipment warranty period and resale value, design algorithms for model solutions, and conduct simulation studies. The paper also conducts model sensitivity analysis so as to provide decision makers with useful references for maintenance strategies.

articleTitle: Voiceprint identification based on model clustering
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: A voiceprint identification method is proposed which be based on the speaker model clustering (SMC). The similar speaker models are clustered through an approximated KL divergence and determine the clustering center and their representatives to construct a hierarchical voiceprint identification model. During the recognition stage, a cluster is selected first by calculating distance between the test vector and clustering center or cluster representatives, then, though computing the logarithmic likelihood between the test vector and the speaker models in the selected cluster, the speaker can be determined with a significant decrease in the amount of computation. The experimental results show that the proposed method can improve the recognition speed about four times faster with a compromise of the accuracy rate as low as 0.95% compared with the traditional Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM). As a conclusion, the SMC method can improve the recognition speed with almost the same accuracy.

articleTitle: Security analysis and the improvement of the sequential multi-signature scheme based on discrete logarithm
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In this paper, a class of sequential multi-proxy signature schemes are attacked. It includes existential forgery attack. The scheme has many shortcomings. A new enhanced and can resist forgery attack sequential multi signature scheme is proposed, which based on the improved of the original scheme. The new scheme improved the parameters of the original scheme, improved parameter improve the shortcomings of the scheme, which set reasonable, it is correct.

articleTitle: Differentially coherent detection for multicarrier spread spectrum communication over power lines
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Power line communications (PLC) are gaining popularity in smart grid applications. However, current PLC systems with high complexity and sensitiveness to impulse noise and carrier frequency error remain difficult to employ for robust communications over highly unpredictable harsh power line channel. This paper presents a low complexity and high flexibility multicarrier (MC) spread spectrum (SS) system by frequency division multiple access (FDMA) approach to cope with hostile environment with multipath frequency-selective fading. With the number of subcarriers given by the length of sampled data block, experimental results demonstrate that the developed system can effectively combat the channel effects by enabling differentially coherent detection between the subcarriers with variable channel spacing, leading to robust communications.

articleTitle: Wireless design of WI-FI of one data acquisition device
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: It is proposed that a kind of WI-FI wireless architecture based on cloud smart data acquisition device is designed in this paper. Hardware structure of wireless WI-FI based on data acquisition device is designed and Wi-Fi driver is developed in the Linux system under the cloud smart device architecture. When designing the application program, the point-to-point AP mode and the multipoint connection at the same time STATION mode can be chosen as the WI-FI mode of cloud smart data acquisition device. With test case showing, low power consumption, data fidelity, high throughput of wireless Wi-Fi technology is suitable for communication of the cloud smart data acquisition device.

articleTitle: A multi-party remote bitstream update protocol using key chains
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Remote update of reconfigurable hardwares is an essential service which enable by Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) through a network. During the remote updating of the configurations of the FPGA cluster, the efficiency of the current two-party bitstream update protocol is low. So these protocols cannot meet the requirement of the FPGA cluster update. In this paper, we propose a multi-party remote bitstream update protocol with forward-secure that ensures bitstream confidentiality and integrity and prevents replay attacks.

articleTitle: Application of induction radio technology in locomotive positioning control
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In this paper, a method of railway locomotive precise positioning has been proposed, based on data transmission and position detection which is realized by electromagnetic coupling between antenna coil box and coding cables, according to electromagnetic induction principle. The position detection with induction radio and the principle of data communication has been introduced, and both general and high resolution position detection methods have been deduced. Then the similar frequency interference noise suppression method has been introduced, which has realized by the arrangement, in which there are two crossed transmission pair lines and one receiving antenna whose cross distant is equal to that of the pair lines. The proposed method has realized high system detection precision and strong anti-interference ability which meet the requirement of locomotive precise positioning control.

articleTitle: Speech dynamic time warping based on ant colony optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The dynamic time warping (DTW) depends much on the accuracy of endpoint detection; the recognition time is too long. The ant colony optimization algorithm is presented to solve the dynamic time warping problem. The algorithm is using adaptive evaporation coefficient, a new state transition rule and so on. The simulation results show that the new algorithm has better global search ability, accurateness than the traditional ant colony algorithm and the traditional DTW; it can provide a better performance in the speech recognition rate.

articleTitle: Project design of a shortwave narrowband difference frequency hopping system
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: At present, limited by platform and working conditions, the majority of shortwave communication equipment can only work under narrowband, thus, researching on DFH communication technology in the context of shortwave becomes necessary. In order to apply the common DFH communication to narrowband communication system, the differences among bandwidth, hopping speed and frequency set should be surely taken into consideration.

articleTitle: A fault diagnosis model of some radar system based on Petri net
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Aiming at the complex problems of fault diagnosis for some radar system, Petri net and fuzzy inference are combined to establish a fault diagnosis Petri net which is with the ability of concurrency processing. The model can not only detect the fault sources according to the fault results, but also detect the result affirmative faults and the potential hidden faults as a result of some fault sources. The affirmative faults and the potential hidden faults are distinguished by setting two threshold values. Then the technicians can take some measures to repair the potential hidden faults. Finally, the model is applied to resolve the faults diagnosis of some radar system, which verifies the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Fourth generation wireless communication network
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication technology, fourth generation wireless system (4G) technology has undoubtedly become a hot topic. This paper first reviews the development history of wireless communication and from them the reason for the shift in turn into the fourth generation wireless communication system. The paper explains the 4G communication system and describes the feature, goal, advantage, reason of leap of 4G communication system. Using examples shows the application prospect of wireless communication in the future.

articleTitle: Structural design of active region in resonant-phonon Terahertz QCL
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The transmission coefficients and wave function of electron in single period of resonant phonon (RP) Terahertz Quantum Cascade Laser active region were calculated with bias by Airy function substitution and transmission matrix methods, distribution of the electron wave function and relationship curve of quasi-bound level (Subband) and bias were obtained. Based on simulation results, a RP Terahertz Quantum Cascade Laser active region structure was designed. The simulation results showed that THz lasing appeared when bias of SP structure was 51.67mV. The wave function corresponding with E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> energy level could overlap at lasing region and related lasing wave which wavelength was 90.0μm and frequency was 3.2 THz was within THz frequency. At population inversion region, the transition energy from E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> to E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> was 38.62meV, which was approximate to the energy of longitudinal optical (LO) phonon. It was good for achieving large population inversions.

articleTitle: Quasi-equal-phase beam compositing algorithm in multi-beam satellite systems
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: In multi-beam satellite systems, users suffer from 3dB power attenuation in beam-edge area. Joint transceiving can be used to improve this situation. It requires signals of several beams (downlink) or several users (uplink) to be equal-phase, which needs channel estimation and seems to be complex. The purpose of this paper is to reduce complexity of joint transceiving by compositing quasi-equal-phase beams. Firstly, radiation pattern of original component beams are discussed and calculated. Then a modified Least Mean Square (LMS) algorithm is presented to composite quasi-equal-phase beams from component beams calculated above. Lastly a numerical calculation is presented to show that quasi-equal-phase beams are composited with phase error smaller than 0.32 radian.

articleTitle: Research and analysis of Internet QoS performance
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: This subject is to evaluate DiffServ performance, using simulation methods. This is because it's difficult to use mathematical models to accurately portray the end of DiffServ QoS features, and to build a complete test environment actually is very difficult, so the use of simulation methods to study is a more feasible approach. Experiments using NS-2 simulator developed by the Lawrence Berkeley nation lab, making the definition of an AF-PHB group implementation mechanism based DiffServ network model on TSW 3CM strategy, and another complete DiffServ network topology model. After simulation, we get analysis about performance and get numerical results. Ultimately get DiffServ IP QoS technology to ensure the advantages and how to use the DiffServ technology to protect important data from lost.

articleTitle: A priori estimate and nonexistence of nonnegative nontrivial entire solutions for a nonlinear elliptic equation paper title
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Using the test function method, we derive a priori estimate of a nonlinear differential equation and establish conditions sufficient to ensure the nonexistence of nonnegative entire solutions.

articleTitle: High azimuth resolution imaging algorithm for space targets bistatic ISAR based on linear prediction
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: Bistatic inverse synthetic aperture radar (ISAR) makes use of non-back echo of target to form image, which solves the problem that the monostatic ISAR image could not be formed in some particular motion conditions. Due to the existence of bistatic angle, the azimuth resolution of bistatic ISAR is far smaller than the monostatic ISAR with the same bandwidth. To solve this problem, linear prediction algorithm is introduced to bistatic ISAR image. Based on the approximately linear character of azimuth echo, echo data is extended back and forth at the same time to expand bistatic echo. Equivalent pulse accumulation time is enhanced and the azimuth resolution is improved. Simulation experiment validates the efficiency of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Study of broad sensing system model based on the IoT with heterogeneous devices
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The Internet of Things(IoT) composed of large-scale and heterogeneous devices can be considered as a broad sensing system. This paper presents a comparison, in terms of scalability, heterogeneity and query complexity, among three types of data management solutions in sensing systems - wireless sensor networks (WSN), Database Stream Management Systems (DSMS), and hybrid schemes. Based on the open source project Churkwa of Apache, a data accessing model is designed in this study. This model adopts the structure of hybrid schemes, integrates the various computing tasks with the concepts of data management, and distributes operations, such as data collection, data integration, data query, and data evaluation, to suitable layers for handling. Regarding to the inconsistency caused by the concurrency management and control of devices, FOCC algorithm is optimized in this paper, and centralized FOCC concurrency control mechanism is adopted in the model. This model provides references for the data management in the sensing system of the IoT with heterogeneous devices.

articleTitle: Study on wireless resource consumption of mobile applications in GPRS
publicationTitle: 2013 3rd International Conference on Consumer Electronics, Communications and Networks
abstract: The success of mobile Internet brings about data tsunami and huge impact on the Internet, especially 2G network. Application behaviors such as the heartbeat, frequent connection and short package lead to the abuse of wireless network resources in GPRS. In this paper, we study CCCH channel resource consumption of mobile applications with 2G data service.
